mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level (as of t-1mo) is associated with a higher probability of negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting the negative impact of restrictive monetary policy on equity valuations.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 20d returns is greater than or equal to -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightness condition, defined as the unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% (as of t-1mo), signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE level and 5d returns is greater than or equal to -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in labor force participation (PAYEMS) and a contraction in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and RSAFS decline fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (PAYEMS change * RSAFS change) is less than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% as of t-1mo), the expectation of monetary policy tightening suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL level and 20d returns (conditional on CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) is greater than or equal to -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level (INDPRO) as of t-1mo indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO level and 5d returns is less than or equal to 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% (as of t-1mo) signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 60d returns (conditional on FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) is greater than or equal to -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market boom, defined as housing starts exceeding 1800 thousand units (HOUST > 1800 as of t-1mo), signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1800, or the Rank IC between HOUST level and 20d returns (conditional on HOUST > 1800) is less than or equal to 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and a contraction in real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a supply-driven economic imbalance that increases the risk of inflation and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO increase and RSAFS contraction fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (INDPRO change * RSAFS change) is less than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
